pending: hosted shareable non-localhost URL + DNS name + second-device reachability: not built in this strike. The fixture origin (https://lf-host-01.example-tailnet.ts.net:8443) is a made-up name that never resolves, the current host binds 127.0.0.1 only, and a dedicated host/DNS name are owner acts out of scope (no purchase, no DNS work). Device-approval via a second device therefore cannot be shown; the host-side device registry is covered as a stand-in under R4.
